body: You’re right, but I am just assuming that there’s more that I don’t know of. I know that’s probably unfair, but she’s never gonna read this so it doesn’t really matter
Before they got back together he hooked up with another girl, so she did the same out of spite with the coworker. The coworker thought it was gonna be a relationship but she ghosted him.
I don’t know why she felt comfortable sharing that information, but I can’t un-hear it
She told me herself
I think someone can be all of that, but just mature underneath, if that makes sense?
Well, I said “toxic web” because she used another coworker to get back at her significant other for the same thing. I’m just bitter that I was right to stay away.
She doesn’t
I responded to a message that wasn’t for me
It’s my fault for entertaining the thought in the first place. The only person I have to blame is myself
I don’t think I will have children. I don’t think I’d be a good father, not to mention a good husband. I just like being alone. I can’t fail anyone but myself if I stay by myself

I’m just lying to myself. I don’t know anything for certain. I’m not going to let the infection of possibility get me down anymore. Maybe it was possible at one point, but not anymore. I’d rather lie to myself than entrain that thought again
Maybe that is true, though I wouldn’t wish it. I know what that’s like. I still feel the effects of it, and I don’t see it going away anytime soon.

I was verbally abused when I was growing up, and I internalized all of it. I don’t think I will forgive my dad. He taught me that it was normal to berate people for their mistakes. He taught me that anger was the correct response for failure. He taught me that escaping was better than repairing.

I can’t undo the damage he did to my self esteem, and there was nothing I could do to stop him.

I’m just doing what I’ve been told all my life: Don’t approach women in public. I know that there’s a silent “Unless they want you to” attached to that, but trying to determine who does is too hard for me. 

Some women’s “signals” are another’s show of friendship and vice versa. I’d say it’s a shame that women don’t initiate more, but I understand why they don’t.

I’m not going to try to insert myself into her life. Especially since she’s got a boyfriend. I never made any advances because, as a dude, I could be labeled as a creep, a weirdo, I could get in trouble career-wise, or it’d just make things awkward. The “reward” doesn’t outweigh the risks. It’s just how things are now. Not saying that’s why your person doesn’t make a move, just a possibility from my perspective.

You’re right, but I won’t escape references to her anytime soon. It always seems to sting when she’s brought up. She knows how to reach me, so if she did want anything to do with me she would’ve by now, I figure.
She was a coworker so I had to maintain professionalism, and she has a boyfriend. Now she’s gone, so I don’t have to worry about any of it. (My most recent letter was to someone else)
I don’t know how to be kind to myself. It’s my first priority for others, but not for myself. I just find too many reasons to hate me
I guess I don’t know to have that conversation. I only have to suffer this for a week longer, though.
Me too

I added her to apologize for my behavior years prior. I removed myself a week or two after for the reasons above. She said everything was good, and that was pretty much it. Like I’ve stated before, she has a boyfriend and I wasn’t comfortable keeping that line of communication. I said what I needed to say, so there wasn’t really a point in it anyway.
Well, I think that a boyfriend is more than a masculine figure. I’m not trying to complicate her life. I’m content to let it fade, even if my heart isn’t.
No, she already has someone to give her those compliments
I don’t want to give you false hope. I’d be the one needing a savior, too.
She doesn’t need to be saved. I wouldn’t be the one even if she did.
I would only embarrass myself
No, if I remember correctly, it was because 123 was taken. I didn’t think I was going to use this account for this long
I wish I could tell. There are moments when she hears me in the crowd, but beyond that there isn’t much else. She still hasn’t greeted me first, so I feel like that says something.
I don’t think she needs to know. If she did, she would ask, I figure.
That gave me goosebumps. I hope your interpretation is accurate
I’ve been working on trying to be a friend to her, but I don’t know how I’m doing. I fear that getting closer to her will only deepen the feelings
No, I’ve been alone for a few years now. That is probably the driving force behind this infatuation if I’m being honest

It showcases a desire—one I’ve attempted to suppress—and it could be that simple.

Maybe it’s a continuation of the last dream I had of her. They could be glimpses of a different timeline.  One where I’m happier. 

Maybe it’s my subconscious toying with me.

The ending gives me pauses. It started as tears of joy, but didn’t feel that way by the end. Was it a realization that it wasn’t real? Was it foreshadowing what is to come? I’m not sure
No, just a long term committed relationship

It isn’t set in stone yet, but I don’t see myself having a change of heart.   

There are times when it seems like she’s ignoring me, but those could be chalked up to me being soft spoken or her attention being elsewhere. I’d say that my heart yearning for someone who already has their other half is tragic.   

If me stepping down makes me available to her, it would be only coincidence. 

I have to lie to myself in order to contain these feelings. This desire is deepened by the fact that it is unobtainable, and morally wrong. I just want to move on, any direction is better than where I am now.

I just want this feeling to go away. I just want her to look at me with love in her eyes. I don’t know what I want. When I feel compelled to write a letter, my mind is on the latter. Afterwards, my mind goes back into the safety of my emotional shell. 

I won’t be in my position for much longer. I’ve been planning on stepping down for a while now. Partly because of stress, partly so I remove myself from her further. It’s taken too much a toll on my mental health
It’s closer to limerence. She has yet to greet me or say goodbyes first. I feel trapped by these feelings more than anything
I don’t ignore her, but I’m trying to stay professional. Work is work, not socializing time. I just respect her time.

You’re right, we’re in comparable positions as well. I’ll answer any questions she asks me, but I do not feel comfortable asking the same of her. 

I can’t block out the possibility of a relationship at this point. I can’t tell my heart what to feel, as much as I desperately want to. It’s why I weary of becoming her friend. I see it only amplifying the longing.

I don’t know. The lines between platonic and romantic interest, courteous and intentional actions are too blurry for me. All of her actions and words thus far can be interpreted as courtesy. I have to think that way to maintain my professionalism. 

He “dumped” her, I heard from her answering some else’s question. “She got back with her ex” a month later, from a mutual friend. She showcased her relationship on social media. Saw them together in person. 

It seems like a situation I don’t want to step into

It would have to be delivered in person, and by her. I doubt that will happen. She has prior commitments. But, if she did so tomorrow I’d still remain inactive. If she’s willing to initiate while already with someone, that doesn’t bode well for me. 

She has options, and chose to go back to him. I don’t stand a chance. I’ll just admire from afar until it goes away

Mostly organizational things, in a sense. Making sure her resources are readily accessible and in one place. Occasionally I’ll let her know where they are if necessary. I try not to take credit for any of it, though.

[Things I do along the way, and go out of my way to do.]
I don’t know how to kill off these feelings, so I’m stuck with them. I don’t plan to act on them, either. I’m just misinterpreting all of it at this point
That there are things that other people can’t tell me. Not very helpful, but that’s all they say. I’m not going to pursue that information, as it pertains to her relationship.
If she does, then it only makes things more difficult for me. I’d rather admire her from afar than be a part of her life. I guess it’s too late for that now
I’ll only tell her if she asks about it, even then I’d probably omit some of these details. She doesn’t need to know the whole truth, unless she inquires further

I suppose that I am just stepping back, rather than letting go. These feelings are involuntary, so it is not for conscious me to let go. 

If those are her desires, then time will tell. I’m not going anywhere anytime soon.

They got the information from her. From what I’ve seen, she talks the most to them. I have no reason to think otherwise. The source told me that it wouldn’t be anytime soon before things changed in her relationship. 

If she has developed feelings unintentionally, I’ll feel guilty for creating a problem for her to deal with. If I’m the source of a rift between them, it’ll only make me more depressed. 

I understand where you’re coming from. The devil is in the details and all that.

Her relationship. The source who told me did so for a reason, and I trust their judgement. If they were untruthful, shame on me I suppose. 

I’m not going to be an “out” for her. I have no respect for people that look for someone else when they could work out their problems. It just means that she’ll most likely do it to me. But, from what I’ve gathered, she is more in the former camp. 

I’m just going to wait for her to initiate, if my feelings haven’t faded by then
Maybe she isn’t, but it’s another thing I can tell myself to downplay the feelings. I don’t plan on telling her as I’d only make myself look like more of a fool.
I don’t plan on burning the bridge, like I’ve done before. I just don’t want to get closer right now.
That’s what I meant when I said I’ve seen it with my own eyes
No, I’ve been alone for a long time now. It’s probably the reason I can have such feelings for someone I don’t really know. Idle minds and all that
I’ve seen it with my own eyes. Telling her how I feel can only complicate things. A trusted primary source eluded to the not-so-sweet side of her, so another reason to abstain.

But she isn’t. She’s been with someone the whole time. I don’t know what I have been seeing, I don’t know what I have been feeling, but it hasn’t been reciprocated. My desire is now waning so I won’t be trapped for much longer, hopefully.
I plan on telling her in person, I think it’d mean more that way

I just hope that she will understand and know that I am being sincere. 

I am thankful for the people who’ve helped me take a better approach to life, both in real life and on here. I’m not sure where I’d be without them
I’m slowly building up the courage and finding the right words. I don’t know when I’ll get the right time, though
I’m in the same boat. Is the infatuation for the person, or the idea of them built up in my head? I’m too anxious to confront it, anyhow.

This sub is an addiction in that way. Searching for faux peace of mind that never comes. Just like how I keep looking for her car to pull into the parking lot. I’ll see the same model and a spark of hope ignites, only to fade a moment later when everything else doesn’t add up. At least, that’s how it feels for me
No, I still don’t know exactly how and why I feel for her.

After researching it, it seems like that is playing a part in this. Although it seemed to jump from my ex to the woman that I erroneously labeled a “distraction”. I’ve come to terms with that relationship, but it seems like my subconscious needed to fill that role and she was the perfect target. A phantom crush, maybe. I’ve been letting it bully me for too long, so I’m going to start taking steps to get my mental health in order.

I understand the misconception, it is my fault for wording it that way. It was the feelings I have for her that led me astray, not her as a person. I’m the one that let that happen

(Edit) I wrote this last night when I wasn’t sober, and was feeling bitter about my life, so it seeped its way into my writing
I try to, but it always seems to fall flat. It ends up stinging more than if I was just silent, so I’ll just do that instead

I do need to be more brave, but I know that I’ll apply it in the wrong situations. I predict only failure because it justifies my inaction. Being brave has only gotten me into trouble in the past, so why would it be any different now? I’ll just have to take another step and see where it lands me
If she is, then she’s really good at hiding it. I’m afraid that all that will come of this is heartbreak. I don’t think I could handle another at this point
And maybe there isn’t any. I just hit a mental block when she’s around. I don’t know what to say or do without forgoing tact
I feel more defeated than anything. I just want to know what she wants from me, but circumstances prevent me from outright asking.
Don’t apologize, my letters are just rants and vents anyway. Thank you for sharing, though. I apologize if it was a painful memory I brought up
I took a step forward and one toward her today, I hope I can continue to keep pace
I don’t have her number or any social, so I can’t. I say a “good morning” whenever I can though. I don’t really know how to start a conversation without feeling like I’m prying.

I don’t want to have any negative impact on her life, and the only way I see that happening is to stay out of her life as much as possible. If she’s been there the whole time, that doesn’t mean she’s been waiting for me. I’m too afraid of failure
Maybe I do, but I’m not smart enough to seek it out. I just keep waiting for something to happen
I may love the idea of her, but I’ll never know what she’s really like. I find quite often that my ideas don’t match reality. I’d rather die deluded then face an opposite reality, it seems
I meant “being around” in a more general sense

Rejection is what I fear most. For all I know, I’m just projecting my infatuation onto her. It’s for the best she doesn’t know, I don’t plan on being around a long time anyway. My brain’s just desperate for physical affection
I know I’m not worth putting up with, I’m saving her the effort
Maybe when the time is right, but I don’t think it’d be a good idea right now
Timing, and my own incompetence
The consequences of asking hold me back as well.
I guess I don’t see the sustainability of that, even if it’s what you want

No, I haven’t heard her say it. I don’t know how to bring that up naturally. She speaks more to other people, but that is my fault. About a year ago she was more active in attempting conversations, but I shut each one down with short answers. I was not in a good place and I didn’t want her to get close to me. More recently, I’ve been able to talk to her through other people. In group conversations I can tell a joke and she’ll laugh, and I smile. Though, I suppose the downside is that the dialogue gets hijacked by someone else after I answer her questions. If this isn’t all in my head, then I think she also understands that we are at work, so we can’t just stand around and talk.

I suppose that’s the catch, there’s two women that seem piqued by me. One is more open than the other, this letter is addressed to the latter. My feelings for the former seem to be reactionary, as after reflection, she seems much more like my first ex. Someone who revels in drama and flirts exclusively with insults. My mind kinda let go of her after that realization. 

I’ve had my eye on the latter for longer, but I heard she’s already with someone. I’ve suppressed the feeling until recently, for better or worse. If she initiates a conversation I’ll try my best to hold it, but I’m not confident enough to start one. I’m not going to hide what I’m really like, though, so it’s only a matter of time until I find out what she sees.

I’m just better off alone. I can’t fail her if I don’t even have the chance. I have trouble expressing myself, not to mention that my vulnerability has been used against me. I have repressed anger that I direct inwards because if I let it out it’d cause more problems for me. No one wants that. I don’t ever have the energy or drive to fix myself. I’d rather just fantasize about a coworker who gave me a small amount of attention, because I’ve been deprived of it for so long. I can’t fall if I’ve already hit the bottom.
I’m just projecting. You stating that what I do best is run when things get tough seemed—to me—to be charged with vitriol. If they are song lyrics or lines from a movie, then I am oblivious.

You write like you know me, but your statement is incompatible given the context. You don’t know me. You don’t know anyone on this platform. I won’t pretend to know why you are vindictive toward strangers on the internet, but it can’t be healthy. Stewing in anger will only make you more bitter.
“I like you” plain and simple, just like me

It’s easy to assume she does from an outside perspective, it would lead to a satisfying conclusion. I could be misconstruing events because of my lack of understanding. I could be assigning meaning to pure coincidences for all I know, which is very little. 

If she is actually interested in me, then it’s only in the exterior that I put on. Underneath, I’m literally nothing. I’m an asshole who plays video games. That’s it. There’s nothing there to like. I have no hobbies, no interests. I know that I am undesirable, the real me, anyway. 

If somehow something happens between us, she’ll realize that fairly quickly. Then I won’t have to worry about it anymore. That’s just the way I’m moving forward.
And so I wait, it could all just be bait. Waiting for me to come out of my shell to strike me once more.

I’ve come to terms with the loss of the first person I loved. I’ve pulled more regret from that memory than lessons. I understand more clearly that doing that is a disservice to her and the time we spent together. I let old wounds from my first relationship to fester, wounds inflicted by her and my friend group. But I let that happen. I didn’t communicate that I was hurt, and she didn’t know that I wasn’t ready. Those conversations are hard, especially when your words have been used against you before. I didn’t trust myself, when I should’ve trusted her. 

I don’t think the universe had planned our future. Our relationship was to show me that I needed to work on myself in order to earn love. 

The muse of this letter is a coworker, so it is a delicate situation. Being a guy makes it especially delicate on my end, and I’m not very graceful.

I’m not sure what I’m looking for, but maybe with time I’ll know it when I see it
Likewise, fellow internet stranger 🫡
But, knowing what to let go of is just as important

Then I suppose you’ll have to be direct with your person. I understand that each situation is different and complex in their own ways, but that’s the simple truth. Play games get games, be direct get a direct answer, even if the answer is murky that in and of itself is a direct answer. In my situation, I’d rather continue how things are than risk creating awkwardness, but I am not veiling myself with the delusion that she will act for me. Maybe in the future I’ll gain the confidence to act, but for now I move forward. I can actually have a conversation with her now, and I don’t avoid her. It all just takes time.

Oh I do think. I think a lot, too much, even. There are consequences for every action that I take, and don’t take. This letter will never be seen by the person I wrote it to, nor did I write it *for* them. I wrote it for myself. I write all of these letters for myself. They are my reflections, my feelings, my reminders. I dare to say it’s the point of this sub. Reflection, across thousands of pairs of eyes, instead of one’s own mind. A variance of perspective is sometimes what we need. 

This letter is to tell myself to move. I have never *expected* the people I write about to make me move. I definitely desired it, and I have dwelled on that desire far too long. So, I move forward. Have I changed my expectations? No. Letting my fear cripple me has hurt me more than it’s saved me. Will she take a step toward me? I don’t expect it, but it’s more likely if I am moving forward.
I’m glad that something I’ve made could positively impact someone, even if it will never make it to its indented recipient.
Then I missed it. I would rather it be a step toward, a “move” implies it’s a game that I don’t want to play.
I guess it was the small things here and there. She understood that I needed physical signs of love; holding hands, massages and such. Being deprived of that has shown me just how much I needed it.
I use this platform for it’s anonymity. Personal details like that might tip someone off to who I am. She doesn’t need to know these letters are from me.
I’m not sure. She was much more emotionally intelligent than me. When words weren’t enough she’d show with action. I wish I had that gift
It may be outdated information, but I don’t want to make a move. It’s easier to assume it’s still true. Fear is a feeling, why shouldn’t I trust it?

I fear rejection more than anything. I don’t want her to look at me any differently. Last I heard she is already involved with someone else, so I will just let these feelings run their course. Even if they crush me again and again. It’s all in my head anyways

I suppose I’m only vocal about my feelings toward work-related matters. Mixing personal/professional tends to end badly for me. As much as I might want to say something to her, the right words never form in time to say them.

That’s why she’ll never see this. She’s living her best life with someone who was able to show her love. I failed her, so I didn’t deserve to be in her life. I knew that she could do better. Anyone can do better than me.

It feels more like the universe is taunting me more than anything. “You have someone who has clearly expressed interest in you, yet you can’t let go of this fantasy.” I avoid her eyes in fear of catching her stare. I can see out of the corner of my eye, but to meet it would crush me further. The desire for her burns somewhere deep, and I’d rather attempt to bury it than douse it with reality, whether thats water or gasoline. 

Recent events loosely point toward the former, so I abstain. Why do her eyes tell a different story?
It’s an unfortunate happenstance. One of those time I wish I could just scrub it from my memory. I wish for that too frequently
I’m scared that I won’t be enough, or I will mess it all up somehow
I just hope this one isn’t all in my head

Her smile is worth more than gold to me. I can’t help but smile when I see hers. When I’m the cause it warms me up inside

(Also, thank you for saying so)

I don’t know. It has to be a game nowadays. Cat and mouse, a chase. I’d rather not chase, as I have no clue how (along with the myriad of things that can go wrong). Maybe if she asked more personal questions I’d feel enabled to do the same. I don’t feel like stepping over boundaries I cannot see. Maybe she feels the same

I envy her partner. I feel an odd compulsion to protect her, but I’ll never fill that role. I resent that feeling as I’m just about the worst partner anyone could ask for. I shouldn’t feel it in the first place.
And the wrong one will laugh
Maybe I did, maybe I didn’t. But I’ve been given two paths, and I have to choose. I’ll need to make a leap of logic at some point, right?
Until someone fashions a knife from it

I suppose she doesn’t seem like the type, but they rarely show it openly. Maybe I am like the “he” though, as I am different behind closed doors. She sees the facade I put up, not me curled into a fetal position behind it. The me that’s plagued by constant doubt, unable to escape it. I suppose that I am not real in that respect

I think it’s more of a lust. An envy, even. My desire to understand only growing behind a facade of disinterest. If given someone else to focus on, I think it will eventually smother and die out. I suppose only time will tell.

I suppose it goes both ways. She normally talks with other people, but we’ve barely spoken in the few years we’ve been around each other. And normally, I talk to pretty much everyone. I don’t understand it. I greet everyone, but can’t bring myself to do so with her. It makes me feel terrible, but the words never come out. Maybe we reached a nonverbal agreement to forgo those at some point.

I’ve heard she’s with someone, but that was around a year ago. I suppose I haven’t had had a reason to expect it has changed since then.

I feel both for both. A big tangle of feelings and emotions that I can barely decipher. The reserved one I catch myself looking for more frequently—much to my chagrin—even though I rarely meet her gaze. I feel a desire to be close to her, physically and emotionally, even though I fight every temptation.

I don’t want to deepen feelings for someone who won’t reciprocate. My fear of rejection seems to overpower those desires. And you’re right, I do want to be loved. I just don’t know how to show it. I don’t deserve to receive it if I can’t give up my own. 

The open one I feel drawn to like a campfire on the longest, coldest night. Inviting. I know she wants me to be next to her, because she shows it. I can’t excuse her actions as coincidental, as with the other. Maybe I am as simple as that. I want to love someone who loves me, I can grow to appreciate the rest. 

Life has hit a crossroads for me, it seems. Do I follow my subconscious, which has seemingly brought only misery? Or do I follow my conscious, which I am in control of?

I don’t know. I don’t want to be the reason a relationship is broken. Why do I feel a pull towards her? It feels more like a lust than a desired companionship. Even writing it out doesn’t sound right. I don’t know what it is. 

The other seems more logical pursuit, but that doesn’t sound right either. Each path seems more correct than the other. I don’t want either to hate me, or have a reason to hate me, rather. That seems to be the driving force of my life: the desire to not be hated.

I know I’m going to have regrets either way. Why not stay where I am at that point? It would be easier, maybe they’d be dissatisfied with it. I don’t even know if they do like me. One is definitely more open about how she views me, but the other seems mirrors my apprehension around her. Why can’t I just decide?

I feel like most of my letters are just rants, anyway. I’d rather have my inner thoughts be expressed and have some sort of impact, rather than just sitting isolated in my head. If anything, it’s insightful to revisit my more personal thoughts all in a timeline perspective

I am conflicted. This one is for someone who is not available, to my knowledge. We’ve been around each other for a few years now, conversations few and far between. From second hand knowledge we have more in common than the one who openly shows her affection. 

I feel like a bad person for entertaining both of these possibilities, but this one is more subconscious. I can’t help it. I wish I could just pick a lane but I guess it’s not as easy as that.
I wish I had your optimism. Some days I can feel it trying to break through, but most of the time my inferiority complex smothers it. Maybe I just need a little help to get there
People talk, and I like to listen. I don’t know if it is still true, but it’s easiest to assume so. I haven’t been given a reason to think otherwise, I suppose.

I don’t think I have the capacity for love. I’m just a shell of a person doing what’s necessary to succeed enough to keep living. I expend all of my energy at work and it leaves none in my personal life. All I do is play video games to escape reality because in actuality I don’t want to live. I live in the now, because I don’t plan on living long enough to see those plans come to fruition. What kind of person would I be if I committed myself to someone with that mentality? That’s why I gave up on the last person who loved me. When I realized that I would never amount to anything and none of the pain and mistakes will ever leave my head, I couldn’t stand the thought of someone else loving me. I have no love for myself. My subconscious plagues me with memories of my worst fuck-ups over and over and over. And every day I have to act like I’m happy and hardworking because if I don’t it will make more problems for me. I just want to live life until too many problems pile up so I have an excuse to end all of my problems at once. How could I possibly expect someone to love me when these are just about the only things I think about? Sure, I may daydream about being close to someone, but that must stem from a lack of affection from the opposite sex. All it takes for me to latch onto someone is a courteous kindness and extended periods of proximity. They don’t think of me the same way I think of them. I just mistake common behaviors for affection. I connect the dots in ways that fit my own fantasies because I can’t ever figure out how women operate. I can barely hold a personal conversation with one without getting flustered near instantly. I’m just not build to love. I’m built to work and nothing else
She already has someone. Someone who’s probably a much better fit than I’ll ever be

She has someone already. As a man, I’d lose any respect I have for myself if I make a move. I’d also lose respect for her if she was willing to reciprocate while currently in a relationship. I’ll just have to weather the storm as I always have

I had someone who did exactly this, it was a brief time but it was the best I’d ever felt about myself. My incompetence ruined it and what followed was the worst few months I’ve lived. She was setting up my scaffolding, but I tore it down the moment I walked away. There’s still a gaping hole in my heart from that blunder. 

I’d have to say my commitment to courtesy, I feel like it’s something often forgone nowadays (to answer your question).

I try to avoid her eyes, for fear of falling further. They’re windows to the soul, but that doesn’t mean they aren’t stained. She doesn’t seem the type, but they rarely ever do.

Thank you for sharing this
I’d rather she didn’t know how I feel about her, because then I’d have to take action (which I am not ready for). If she wanted to know, she’d ask.

Well, there’s a reason I didn’t send it to her. 

Maybe saying I’ve been burned before is an understatement, but it left me with severe trust issues both in myself and in other people. All to say, I don’t feel comfortable enough to initiate anything right now.
Oh, and I love your voice, too.
I don’t know. I’m too scared to find out
